In Proxmox einen unprivilegierten Debian: Create an unprivileged Debian 12 LXC (amd64) in Proxmox with LAN access. For 30–50 devices, start with 2 CPU cores, 4 GB RAM and 32 GB disk. Local MongoDB requires AVX. Copy the archive and matching SHA256SUMS from the same release tag to /root on the Proxmox host; replace 123 in the host shell with your container ID.
In der LXC-Konsole als root ausführen. D: Run as root in the LXC console. The archive contains the built frontend. The script installs Python, local MongoDB and the energieboard service. Use only for a new installation. For external MongoDB and direct installation from GitHub, see docs/en/INSTALLATION.md.
Der Dienst startet beim Hochfahren des C: The service starts when the container boots. Restrict port 8000 to trusted devices or use a reverse proxy with access control.
Im Browser die IP des LXC-Containers auf: Open the LXC IP on port 8000 in your browser. Under Data acquisition, create API (ioBroker, Home Assistant, evcc or custom), MQTT or Modbus TCP connections and measurements. Under Configuration, create the grid connection first, then nodes, devices and batteries. InfluxDB and recording are under System.
Das Update sichert Anwendung, Datenbank: The update backs up the application, database and configuration. Measurement IDs and history are preserved. A failure restores the backup. Only for direct LXC installations. Update Docker using a Git tag and Compose. For later releases, choose the required fixed tag.
